title: Visual Abstention in Unified Multimodal Models
abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate understanding and generation, yet their generative behavior is rarely governed by what they understand about the task. We formalize visual abstention: when a requested visual transformation is impossible under the task's rules, the model should recognize that no valid solution exists, state this, and decline to generate. We introduce Draw-or-Decline (DoD), a benchmark of 1,050 feasible-infeasible request pairs across 7 task categories that jointly measures editing success and the refusal of infeasible requests. Evaluating 8 UMMs, we find that editing ability and abstention are distinct capabilities: even the strongest editor, at 68.4% editing accuracy, refuses only 0.4% of infeasible requests under ordinary instructions. Their reasoning shows why: the models rarely notice the conflict, and instead plan the edit as if the request were possible, often describing objects that are not in the image, or quietly change the request into one they can complete. Explicitly prompting these UMMs to report infeasibility increases textual refusals but reduces editing accuracy. We propose VisTA (Visual Transformation and Abstention), a training method that pairs feasible and infeasible examples so that a model judges feasibility before deciding whether to generate. We train VisTA-BAGEL to perform feasible edits and decline infeasible requests. Without any reminder, it refuses 93.0% of infeasible requests, up from 0.4% for the strongest editor, while falsely refusing only 0.8% of feasible ones. Unlike a reminder, this does not cost editing accuracy: VisTA-BAGEL completes 74.3% of feasible edits, more than any of the 8 evaluated UMMs.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.07887v1 的 25 页全文与关键图表核验整理。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: VisTA 让 unified editor 在“存在合规edit吗”判断后才draw，用pairedfeasible/infeasible监督把拒绝连接到真正无image的EOS。作者报告DoD拒绝93.0%、false拒绝.8%、edit74.3%，对设计约束守恒很有用；相对feasible-only72.0%的小edit增益不足定论，训练/测试同7类synthetic规则，广义可行性尚未证明。
analysis.motivationZh: 图像编辑指令可能包含无法同时满足的约束，而模型仍会生成一个破坏约束的结果；文字上拒绝也未必阻止绘图。论文关注让 unified editor 先判断编辑是否可行，并在不可行时真正停止图像输出。
analysis.methodZh: DoD1050minimalpairs含6类UniREdit synthetic scenes及150BFSmaze，missingtarget/规则冲突构造不可行请求。VisTA由UniREditBAGEL全量finetune，38224pairs的feasible训练CoT+imageflow，infeasible训练具体conflict+普通[ABSTAIN]+EOS且无image，text/image分别token归一。推理marker停止imagegeneration。已读全部25页正文及benchmarkconstruction、nativeinterfaces、judge/humanverification、training、heldoutcategoryappendix。
methodFlow: 同image改instruction或同mazeinstruction改一个corridor，双MLLMcrosscheck并由human/BFS确认feasibility。
从UniREditBAGEL冻结ViT/VAE并finetune其余参数，CE监督所有reasoning，flowloss仅feasibleimage。
训练50%remindermix并让pairedexamples在同batch，避免只学prompt拒绝。
推理先reasoning，出现marker结束并不draw，否则生成合规edit；分别计edit/refusal/false-refusal。
analysis.experimentsZh: DoD2100requests=7×150pairs，900syntheticreal-scene+150maze(7/9/11grid)，3humanreview修4requests。训练76448examples/38224pairs，8H20016384steps~58GPUh，batch4pairs、lr2e-6、same640px/50flowstepsCFG4/2评测。8UMM和4VLM→QwenImageEditpipeline；KimiK3judge。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告no-reminder VisTA E74.3/D93.0/Df.8% vs初始化UniREdit68.4/.4/0；reminderVisTA73.6/93.4。（Sec.5.3/Table5, PDF p.9）；作者报告generic-refusal无具体reasoning ablation E66.3/D80.1，mazeD41.3vs96，提示scene-linkedreasoning有效。（Table12, PDF p.24）；作者报告heldoutmotion E61.3/D90.7接近full62.0/91.3；heldoutmazeE48/D94与full88/96区分。（Table13, PDF p.25）；作者报告judgehumanagreement textual197/20098.5%、editing194/20097%；两sample按judgepositive/negative平衡。（Appendix B.4, PDF pp.17–18） 对照范围：8UMMnativeinterface有的强制image，因此全部lenientcredit；decouplewithoutreminder被systemprompt要求rewrite而不能stop，withreminder新markerformat可跳editor，所以不能把pipeline差距全部归unifiedarchitecture。checkpoint revisions公开且samepromptconditions有控制，single-seed/noCI。 消融与诊断：sameinit/stepsfeasible-only(每step8feasiblevsVisTA4)、genericrefusal同50%remindermix、leaveoutmaze/motion。no-reasoning控制支持具体reasoning而非marker alone；feasible-only的reminderhistory不同且训练image量2倍，论文明确承认小gain不确定。
analysis.insightZh: 目标与pairedtraining协议把feasibility理解和generationcontrol真正耦合，适合设计rules的生成边界；架构、CE/flowobjective本身传统，不是新基础UMM。minimalpairs/heldoutcategory比单promptbenchmark更强，但尚局限syntheticmissingreferent和maze规则。
analysis.evidenceZh: visualabstention严格定义需文字拒绝且无image，但既有模型主表采用lenienttext-onlycredit。（Sec.2 Eqs.(4)/(6), PDF pp.3–4; Sec.4.1, pp.5–6）；infeasible样本无image，CE包含EOS而flowloss仅feasible并按存在image tokens归一。（Sec.5.1 Eq.(10), PDF p.8; Appendix C.2, pp.22–23）；feasible-only同stepscontrol不支持显著edit增益归因infeasiblepairs。（Table5, PDF p.9; Appendix C.5, pp.23–24）；held-outmaze拒绝泛化但解题gain不泛化。（Appendix C.7/Table13, PDF pp.24–25）
analysis.caveatZh: Appendix C.5/C.7 pp.23–25承认singletraining/scoringrun无CI、小editgap接近judge disagreement。；C.1 p.22只有300pairhumantrainingaudit，2unusablepair仍保留；pixel/mazerotation去重不排semantic场景相似。；A.2 p.14明确所谓real-worldcategory的sourceimages也是synthetic，非naturalphotos。；7类同规则/同UniREdit来源训练与benchmark，heldout2类拒绝迁移不足证明arbitraryCAD/fabrication可行性。；Dtextrefusal无需reason正确，另91.8%verifiedreason应与93%decision分开。；generationgating易implement，不代表model对所有constraints有symboliccertificate。；MLLM生成/验证/judge同Kimi家族可能style偏差，humanbalancedaudit不代表全benchmarkprevalenceaccuracy。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接研究visualcreation中可行指令与保持约束的冲突，设计agent/生成器应把可行性判断绑定execution；不是普通VQAbenchmark，有pairedmodeltraining及实质generationcontrol贡献。
